text: Boss said 'Let's discuss your performance.' Cluck.
HR said to bring a support person. I brought my brother.
We're not scared. We just got the 'free lunch' email.
He asked who ate the office donuts. We both froze.
Sir, the early bird got the worm. Where's my raise?
Meeting could've been an email. We're now in costumes.
My in-laws arrived early again. Act natural.
